{"lean_source":"import Std

namespace DagContract

inductive Edge where
  | edge (src dst : Nat)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Input where
  n : Nat
  edges : List Edge
  deriving Repr

inductive Output where
  | null
  | edgeList (edges : List Edge)
  deriving Repr

def valid (x y : Nat) : Prop := x ≤ 10 ∧ y = 0

def edgeSrc : Edge → Nat
  | .edge u _ => u

def edgeDst : Edge → Nat
  | .edge _ v => v

def edgeLe (a b : Edge) : Bool :=
  if edgeSrc a < edgeSrc b then true
  else if edgeSrc b < edgeSrc a then false
  else edgeDst a ≤ edgeDst b

def hasEdge (es : List Edge) (e : Edge) : Bool := es.contains e

def uniqueEdges : List Edge → List Edge
  | [] => []
  | e :: es => if hasEdge es e then uniqueEdges es else e :: uniqueEdges es

def insertSorted (e : Edge) : List Edge → List Edge
  | [] => [e]
  | x :: xs => if edgeLe e x then e :: x :: xs else x :: insertSorted e xs

def sortEdges : List Edge → List Edge
  | [] => []
  | e :: es => insertSorted e (sortEdges es)

def walk (es : List Edge) (fuel src dst : Nat) : Bool :=
  if fuel = 0 then src = dst
  else if src = dst then true
  else es.any (fun e => edgeSrc e = src && walk es (fuel - 1) (edgeDst e) dst)

def hasCycleFrom (es : List Edge) (n v : Nat) : Bool :=
  es.any (fun e => edgeSrc e = v && walk es n (edgeDst e) v)

def hasCycle (es : List Edge) (n : Nat) : Bool :=
  (List.range n).any (fun v => hasCycleFrom es n v)

def alternatePath (es : List Edge) (n u v : Nat) : Bool :=
  (List.range n).any (fun w => w ≠ u && w ≠ v && walk es n u w && walk es n w v)

def reducedEdges (es : List Edge) (n : Nat) : List Edge :=
  sortEdges ((uniqueEdges es).filter (fun e => !alternatePath es n (edgeSrc e) (edgeDst e)))

def solve (data : Input) : Output :=
  if hasCycle data.edges data.n then Output.null
  else Output.edgeList (reducedEdges data.edges data.n)

def reachable (es : List Edge) (n u v : Nat) : Bool := walk es n u v

theorem cyclic_returns_null (data : Input) :
    hasCycle data.edges data.n = true → solve data = Output.null := by sorry

theorem acyclic_returns_reduction (data : Input) :
    hasCycle data.edges data.n = false →
    solve data = Output.edgeList (reducedEdges data.edges data.n) := by sorry

theorem reduction_sorted_unique (es : List Edge) (n : Nat) :
    reducedEdges es n = sortEdges ((uniqueEdges es).filter (fun e => !alternatePath es n (edgeSrc e) (edgeDst e))) := by sorry

theorem preserves_reachability (es : List Edge) (n u v : Nat) :
    hasCycle es n = false →
    reachable es n u v = reachable (reducedEdges es n) n u v := by sorry

theorem retained_edges_irredundant (es : List Edge) (n : Nat) (e : Edge) :
    hasCycle es n = false → hasEdge (reducedEdges es n) e = true →
    alternatePath (reducedEdges es n) n (edgeSrc e) (edgeDst e) = false := by sorry

theorem output_shape_and_order (data : Input) :
    solve data = Output.null ∨
    ∃ es, solve data = Output.edgeList es ∧
      es = sortEdges ((uniqueEdges data.edges).filter (fun e => !alternatePath data.edges data.n (edgeSrc e) (edgeDst e))) := by sorry

theorem standard_total_reference (data : Input) :
    ∃ out, solve data = out := by sorry

theorem non_vacuity :
    (∃ n m, valid n m ∧ solve ⟨n, []⟩ = Output.edgeList []) ∧
    (∃ n m, valid n m ∧ solve ⟨n, [Edge.edge 0 0]⟩ = Output.null) := by sorry

end DagContract","formalization":{"schema_version":"0.1","artifact_kind":"formalization_candidate","profile_id":"dag_transitive_reduction.v0_1","lean_toolchain":"leanprover/lean4:v4.34.1","lean_file":"Contract.lean","bindings":[{"obligation":"D1","declarations":["DagContract.Edge","DagContract.Input","DagContract.Output"]},{"obligation":"D2","declarations":["DagContract.solve"]},{"obligation":"O1","theorem":"DagContract.cyclic_returns_null"},{"obligation":"O2","theorem":"DagContract.acyclic_returns_reduction"},{"obligation":"O3","theorem":"DagContract.preserves_reachability"},{"obligation":"O5","theorem":"DagContract.output_shape_and_order"},{"obligation":"O4","theorem":"DagContract.standard_total_reference"}],"internal_obligations":[{"id":"W1","kind":"non_vacuity","theorem":"DagContract.non_vacuity","witnesses_for":["D1"],"description":"valid success and error cases exist"}]}}
